annotations.title: Venture timing: when to commit, which business

description:
Use this when the user asks when to start, launch, sign, borrow or expand a business, or which line of business their chart supports.
A calendar of the coming months in four labels — commit (sign, open, launch), build (keep building; commit only what can be undone), guarded (low fixed cost; no lease, no borrowing) and hold (no new fixed commitments) — each window with the daśā period running and the slow transits of Saturn and Jupiter over it, and the reasons. Describe the businesses being weighed in `ventures` and each is ranked on how strongly the chart supports it and whether the coming periods carry it, with the grounds, its best coming period, and a caution when it needs premises during a hold; name none and the full catalogue of business types is ranked. A ranking of chart support, never a probability of success. Deterministic: no language model is called. The birth time is required.
Cost: 10 credits per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"birthData":{"date":"1990-05-12","time":"14:35","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209},"ventures":["software and data platform for businesses","a restaurant in a leased storefront","OneDot"],"months":36}

birthData.description: The person's birth data. The time is required: every period depends on the rising sign.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, local to `timezone`. Omit if unknown: house-dependent detail is then reduced.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

months.description: How far ahead the calendar runs, and the horizon each venture's period support is averaged over.

ventures.description: Optional: the businesses being weighed, each described by what it does ("software for accountants", "a café with a leased storefront"). A brand name alone cannot be placed and is returned as unclassified. Omit to rank the whole catalogue.

name: get_venture_timing

requestId.description: Quote this in any support request.

sandbox.description: Present and true only on sandbox-key responses: a fixed sample, not computed from your request.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.

transitsRead.description: False when the transit timeline was unavailable and the calendar ran on the daśā periods alone.

peak.description: Jupiter crossing a natal lord of wealth inside a commit or build window.

catalogue.description: True when no ventures were named and the whole catalogue was ranked.

scoring.description: How rank, promise and support are computed.

unclassified.description: Ventures the catalogue could not place from their description — declared, not ranked.

title: Venture timing: when to commit, which business
